notes: Inbound SMB (consumer mental health triage app). Wants self-serve hosted API but needs clear controls for data retention and the ability to opt-out of request logging. HIPAA-adjacent: not storing full PHI, but workflows ingest user-reported symptoms and appointment notes — legal wants conservative posture. Key asks: 1) confirmation that logs can be disabled per-tenant or TTL set to 0; 2) audit/log access + SSO for admin; 3) SOC2 report + data residency guidance for AWS us-east-1; 4) cost estimate for 30 qps sustained with batching. POC so far uses open models, prefer small/medium models for cost. Interested in streaming responses and function-calling to hook into appointment microservice. Quote from product lead: "We need hosting that feels like a utility — fast, cheap, and with controls we can show our counsel." AE notes: client is pragmatic on cost but will escalate to procurement if security answers are satisfactory.
